missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Отец' is masculine and stays in the nominative as the subject of 'работает'. 'Мой' is the agreeing masculine possessive, and 'в больнице' is prepositional of location.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Отца' is the accusative of the animate masculine 'отец' as the direct object of 'люблю'. Note the fleeting vowel: отец drops the 'е' to give отца.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'У отца' uses the genitive 'отца' after 'у' to show whose birthday it is. The fleeting vowel drops again, giving the stem отц-.
Strategic focus: Genitive after 'нет'. 'Отца' is the genitive required by 'нет' to express absence. 'Больше' adds the sense of no longer having one.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Отцу' is the dative of 'отец', the recipient of the gift in 'подарил'. 'Новые часы' is the accusative plural direct object.
Strategic focus: Dative after 'звонить'. The verb 'звонить' governs the dative, so 'отцу' marks who is called. 'Часто' and 'вечером' add frequency and time.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'гордиться'. 'Отцом' is the instrumental of 'отец', required by the verb 'гордиться'. 'Своим' is the agreeing masculine instrumental possessive.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Об отце' uses the prepositional 'отце' after 'об' to name the topic of longing. The fleeting vowel reappears here in the soft ending.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Отцы' is the nominative plural of 'отец', the subject of 'знакомы'. 'Наши' agrees in the plural, showing the noun's plural form.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 'Об отцах' uses the prepositional plural 'отцах' after 'о' to name the topic of conversation. 'Наших' agrees in the plural prepositional.
